articles.summary: WALTHAM, Mass., June 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Xilio Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: XLO), a clinical-stage biotechnology company discovering and developing masked immuno-oncology therapies for people living with cancer, today announced the appointment of Ben Harshbarger as chief legal officer.
articles.title: Xilio Therapeutics Appoints Ben Harshbarger as Chief Legal Officer
